Through the Pipes#000.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#001.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#001.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#002.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#002.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#003.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#003.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#004.src: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#004.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#005.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#005.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#006.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#006.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#007.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#007.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#008.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#008.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#010.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#010.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#011.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#011.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#013.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#013.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#015.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#015.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#016.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#016.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#019.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.

Through the Pipes#020.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.

Through the Pipes#022.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.

Through the Pipes#023.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#025.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.

Through the Pipes#026.src: You aren't getting away from me now!

Through the Pipes#027.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#032.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#037.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#037.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#040.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#045.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#045.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#046.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#046.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#047.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#047.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#048.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#048.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#049.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#049.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#050.src: I could really use your help, and hey I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#050.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#052.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#052.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#053.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#053.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#054.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#054.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#055.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#056.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#058.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#058.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#059.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#059.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#063.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#063.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#067.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#068.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#068.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#069.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#069.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#070.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.

Through the Pipes#073.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#079.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#079.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#081.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#081.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#083.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#099.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#099.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#100.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#100.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#101.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#103.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#103.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#104.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#104.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#108.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#108.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#116.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#116.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#122.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#122.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#139.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#139.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#140.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#140.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#141.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#141.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#145.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#145.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#146.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#146.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#149.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#149.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#151.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#151.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#157.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#157.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#158.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#158.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#159.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#159.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#161.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#161.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#162.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#162.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#166.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#166.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#171.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#171.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#174.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#175.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#177.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#177.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#178.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#178.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#182.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#182.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#184.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#184.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#185.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#185.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu
